title: Nine Miles of Seeing
subtitle: 服务职业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）
meta: 主题语境：服务职业（社会服务与人际沟通·服务行业与职业）　|　核心词汇：client　|　正文 335 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 client 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1957 my mother was sent to see ① client she could not please, and she said the seeing was the whole of the lesson. The ② client, meaning the customer and not the case, was nine miles away and was seen by whoever came last; client, she said, is the only thing in an office that is judged by how much has been taken out of it.

Every ③ client in that office had the same complaint, and the ④ client at the end, meaning the one the partner kept and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever saw properly. Client, my grandmother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to stay behind; my mother said the patience is the part that gets everywhere.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ client was the whole of the firm, meaning the fee it carried and not the customer. The ⑥ client, meaning the fee and not any of that, is the only thing in a firm that everybody counts and nobody questions; client, he said, is either something you see or the only word that means both a customer and a fee. She said the fee is the part they remember.

By 1972 the ⑦ client had become a number in a report, and the report had become an argument about the complaint. The ⑧ client of the whole thing, my mother wrote in April, was nine miles and eleven years of seeing; client, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to stand on a chair. He said the chair was never mentioned.

The ⑨ client I remember is the one at the end, which was seen in 1977 and is still described as the poorest in the county. A ⑩ client, my grandmother said in 1982, is the only thing that improves by being seen; every client, she said, is a fee that has agreed to look like a customer. She said the fee was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 客户（指那位顾客本身，与那桩案子相对）
C. 固定搭配：see a client 会见一位客户
D. n. 客户（指那间事务所里每一位）
E. n. 客户（指末尾那一位）
F. n. 案源（抽象：它带来的那笔费用）
G. n. 那笔费用（抽象：那件事本身）
H. n. 权衡；整件事的分量（抽象总称）

items.q: The client, meaning the customer and not the case
client was the whole of the firm
the client had become a number in a report
The client of the whole thing
A client, my grandmother said in 1982

answers.why: see a client 意为“会见一位客户”，1957 年母亲被派去会见她讨好不了的那位客户。
client 意为“客户、委托人”，指那位顾客本身而不是那桩案子，在九英里外，由最后来的人会见。
client 指那间事务所里每一位客户，每一位都是同样的抱怨。
client 指末尾那一位（合伙人留下的那一位），是唯一有人认真会见过的。
client 意为“案源”，抽象指它带来的那笔费用，父亲说 client 就是那家事务所的全部。
client 为抽象用法，指那笔费用本身，是一家事务所里人人都算、却没人质疑的东西。
client 意为“客户、委托人”，到 1972 年这位 client 成了报告里的一个数字。
client 意为“权衡、整件事的分量”，母亲四月写道，整件事权衡下来是九英里和十一年的会面。
client 意为“客户”，我记得的是末尾那一位，1977 年会见过，至今仍被说成全县最穷的。
client 为抽象总称，祖母说一位客户是唯一会因为被认真会见而变好的东西。
